title: sample schema
description: Region of a physical specimen on which measurements are performed, e.g. a single pad of a patterned thin film

label.description: Site identifier from the measurement recipe, e.g. r7c10

position.description: Stage position of the site as reported by the instrument

coordinates.description: Position coordinates, in the instrument's axis order

physicalId.description: Identifier of the specimen the sample belongs to, e.g. a wafer or substrate ID
